international_aviation.headline: 英國法院裁定新創航空 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序
international_aviation.summary: 根據官方紀錄，英國破產與公司法院（Insolvency and Companies Court）已裁定計畫營運空中巴士（Airbus）A380 客機的新創航空公司 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序。英國官方公報《The Gazette》於 2026 年 11 月 12 日發布正式公告，證實法院已於 11 月 4 日頒布「清算令」（Winding-Up Order），此項裁決源自 2026 年 5 月向英國法院提出的清算申請。
international_aviation.headline_en: UK court orders compulsory liquidation for A380 startup Global Airlines
international_aviation.summary_en: the Insolvency and Companies Court in the United Kingdom has ordered Airbus A380 startup Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation. The Official Public Record, The Gazette, published a formal notice on November 12, 2026, confirming that the court granted a Winding-Up Order on November 4, 2026. This ruling followed a Petition to Wind Up originally filed with the UK court in May 2026.

new_information: Quantum Systems announced on November 13, 2026, that its drones operated by the Bundeswehr are flying again.
The German armed forces grounded the drones as a precaution following a cyberattack on the manufacturer.
Quantum Systems did not specify when the grounding began or ended, or how many drones were affected.
The German military has not independently confirmed that flights have resumed.
Quantum Systems said in a statement published on November 12, 2026, that it had identified a cybersecurity incident at the end of October.
An investigation remains underway with state authorities and internal and external cybersecurity experts.
AeroTime reported that several SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled due to unpaid airport fees, according to reports shared by assorted Indian news websites.
AeroTime reported that the Hindustan Times claimed four SpiceJet flights from Dubai to Amritsar, Jaipur, Mumbai and Delhi had been cancelled on November 12, 2026.
AeroTime reported that Dubai Airports advised SpiceJet that check-in services would be suspended because of non-adherence to payment conditions.
A SpiceJet spokesperson told the Hindustan Times that the airline was working with relevant authorities to rectify the situation.
The spokesperson said, “We have adequate bank guarantee cover in place and are working to ensure that the issue is sorted out at the earliest.”
